LESSON: SONGS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PERFORMING
Topic 1.1: Songs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Songs
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: When is the national types of songs performed anthem sung?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. sing 3-part rounds, keeping verses of the Kenya National Anthem in to the respective parts for English and or Kiswahili paying enjoyment attention to posture and appropriate
